title: Spelling log
subject: English
intro: Lesson 91: Common exception words: find, kind, mind, old, cold and wild. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: A kind garden
points: Bees find the flowers by their scent
A kind gardener leaves flowers for the bees
Wild flowers grow on their own

keywords.def: a word that does not follow the usual spelling rule
a vowel that says its name: i in find
a smell, often a pleasant one
the stalk that holds up a flower

questions.q: Core: write find, kind, mind, old, cold, gold
questions.a: find, kind, mind, old, cold, gold

questions.q: Extend: write a sentence with kind and wild
questions.a: For example: Be kind to the wild bees.

questions.q: Stretch: write a sentence with behind, most and told
questions.a: For example: Mum told me most bees live behind the shed.

questions.q: In which word does i NOT say /igh/?
questions.a: A) kid. kid: i is short. In kind and wild, i says its name, /igh/.
